name: Local Embedder (Gemma)
description: Local text embeddings via Google's EmbeddingGemma-300M (Apache 2.0). Runs in-process via Transformers.js + ONNX Runtime — no API key, no external service, models cache to /data/transformers-cache. 768-dim native, with Matryoshka truncation to 512/256/128 for faster cosine search. With both this and the gemini-embedder plugin installed, the operator picks the active provider via Settings → Plugins → Embedder Selection.
